subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue first-party CarPlay support in the official iOS app now, and if so which Apple category, entitlement path, and constrained Talk/session UX should it use?
rationale: Current main lacks the feature, and implementation cannot be chosen safely by automation because Apple entitlement/category choice, release signing, driver-safety constraints, and assistant execution boundaries are product decisions.

options.title: Design-gate CarPlay in iOS app
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the Apple category, entitlement/provisioning plan, and minimal voice-first CarPlay UX before any implementation PR.

options.title: Make Siri/App Intent the prerequisite
options.body: Treat native Siri/App Intent spoken ask support as the first Apple voice surface and revisit CarPlay after that boundary is approved and implemented.

options.title: Defer CarPlay for now
options.body: Explicitly decline or backlog CarPlay until stronger demand or a clearer Apple category exists, while keeping current iOS Talk and Watch surfaces as the supported mobile voice paths.

recommendation.title: Design-gate CarPlay in iOS app
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the Apple category, entitlement/provisioning plan, and minimal voice-first CarPlay UX before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Solvely-Colin was explicitly tagged on the issue as the iOS app contact and has recent merged iOS app-surface history relevant to the entry point and UX choice.
